# tagging scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:taggingScheme`](gmeow-taggingScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/taggingScheme>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/tags`](../../slices/tags.md)

The tag scheme within which the tagging act is performed. Functional per relator: one scheme per [`Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md) (the tag itself may belong to multiple schemes).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md) -> [`gmeow:TagScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TagScheme.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:taggingScheme`](gmeow-taggingScheme.md) from [`gmeow:Tagging`](../classes/gmeow-Tagging.md) to [`gmeow:TagScheme`](../classes/gmeow-TagScheme.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
